extracted.intended_audience: Recording Academy members, artists, managers, publicists, and music industry professionals involved in Grammy campaigning
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines governing permissible and prohibited 'For Your Consideration' (FYC) communications, events, gifting, and voter conduct for Grammy awards campaigning. Intended to ensure voting is based on artistic and technical merit and to prevent improper solicitation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Voting based on artistic and technical merits
rubrics_metrics.description: “It is the goal of the Recording Academy to ensure the Grammy Awards process is led in a fair and ethical manner and that voting members make their choices based solely on the artistic and technical merits of the eligible recordings.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This overarching principle is the basis for the other rules; voters should disregard personal friendships, company loyalties, regional preferences, or sales volume/popularity when making selections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Voter Code of Conduct — no undue influence
rubrics_metrics.description: “Voters shall not allow their choices to be suggested, directed or influenced by anything other than their own analysis of merit, including, but not limited to: personal friendships, company loyalties, regional preferences, or sales volume/popularity.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit prohibition on letting non-merit factors influence votes; acknowledged as a longstanding but challenging standard to follow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Voter prohibition on accepting value for votes
rubrics_metrics.description: “Voters shall not accept money or anything of value in exchange for votes, access to other members (member lists and contact information are confidential), submission of materials for Grammy consideration, or any other privilege of Recording Academy membership.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes exchanges for votes, access, submission privileges, or any other membership privileges.

rubrics_metrics.name: No agreements on how to vote (no voting blocs/vote trading)
rubrics_metrics.description: “Voters shall not enter into any agreements or understandings on how to vote. This includes without limitation: ‘Voting Blocs,’ or groups of voters who agree to vote together. ... ‘Vote Trading,’ or offering to vote in any manner in exchange for another’s vote.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers organized group arrangements tied to labels/management/social networks and explicit vote trading.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowed FYC communications — permissible content types
rubrics_metrics.description: FYC communications “include, but are not limited to: emails, mailings, invitations, social media, websites, and print ads.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Permitted content (examples): artwork related to product under consideration; brief, unembellished descriptions of the recording or creators; copies or links to product; links to websites that promote eligible recordings; link to Recording Academy website where Voting and Solicitation Guidelines are posted; lists of the creators who worked on the recording; reference to nominations once nominations are announced (list Category(s) by full name); reference to the Grammy Award with proper registered marks (reference by name only; logo use prohibited).

rubrics_metrics.name: FYC communications must not cast competitors negatively
rubrics_metrics.description: “Cast a negative or derogatory light on a competing recording. Any tactic that singles out the ‘competition’ by name or title is not allowed.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prohibits singling out or attacking other recordings as part of FYC materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not exaggerate or overstate merits
rubrics_metrics.description: “Exaggerate or overstate the merits of the music, an achievement or an individual.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FYC materials must avoid hyperbole or inflated claims about quality or achievements; the article questions how this applies to press releases but the prohibition stands.

rubrics_metrics.name: No use of Recording Academy trademarks/logos in FYC materials
rubrics_metrics.description: “Include any Recording Academy trademarks, logos or any other protected information. Logo use is reserved for paid Recording Academy sponsors or partners.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: References to the Grammy Award may be made by name only; use of official logos is prohibited unless you are a paid sponsor/partner.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not include entry list numbers or category numbers
rubrics_metrics.description: “Include entry list numbers or category numbers.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly disallowed in FYC communications; article notes some practitioners may find this restriction puzzling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not include chart numbers, streams, sales figures, or RIAA awards
rubrics_metrics.description: “Include chart numbers, number of streams, sales figures, or RIAA awards.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quantitative commercial-performance metrics are prohibited from FYC materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: No personal signatures, personal regards, or personal pleas
rubrics_metrics.description: “Include personal signatures, personal regards or personal pleas to listen to the eligible recordings.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FYC communications should be informational rather than solicitous or personally pleading for votes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not misrepresent honors or awards
rubrics_metrics.description: “Misrepresent honors or awards, past or present, received by either the recording or those involved with production.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accuracy of past/present honors must be maintained; falsified or inflated credentials are prohibited.

rubrics_metrics.name: No reference to year or telecast number
rubrics_metrics.description: “Reference the year or the telecast number (i.e., 2023 or 66th Grammy Awards).”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The guideline forbids referencing the year or telecast number in FYC communications; article notes some see this as an odd restriction.

rubrics_metrics.name: FYC communications must include an opt-out option
rubrics_metrics.description: “Such communications are prohibited unless they include an opt-out option.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mass communications must provide recipients a way to opt out of future communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promote only your own recordings — no lobbying for others
rubrics_metrics.description: “Members or their designated publicists are restricted to promoting only their own recordings. There shall be no lobbying on behalf of other members.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publicists and members cannot act as advocates/lobbyists for recordings they do not directly represent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independent FYC events permitted if guideline-compliant
rubrics_metrics.description: “Independent FYC events, programs or activities may be hosted if they adhere to the guidelines set forth in this document.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Events are allowed but must follow the same restrictions on gifts, hospitality, and other solicitation practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: No complimentary meals, alcohol, gifts, or hospitality implying value
rubrics_metrics.description: “FYC activities may not include any complimentary meals, alcoholic beverages, gifts, or any other hospitality that could be inferred as a value in exchange for vote consideration. Anything considered by the Recording Academy, in its sole discretion, as unreasonable promotion or gifting is prohibited.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hosts should avoid any hospitality that might be construed as buying influence; the Academy has discretion to judge what is unreasonable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ticketed FYC events must be purchased at full price
rubrics_metrics.description: “If members are invited to a ticketed FYC event or program, they must purchase tickets at full price (no comps or discounts).”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No complimentary or discounted tickets may be offered to members in connection with FYC events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gifting show tickets — limited personal-affiliation exception
rubrics_metrics.description: “[In the] normal course of business, talent [may] provide, and members [may] accept, individual ticket access and meet-and-greet opportunities through their own personal affiliations. However, widespread gifting of show tickets to members as part of an explicit or implicit FYC/vote solicitation campaign is not allowed.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Personal-affiliation gifts are tolerated, but organized or widespread gifting as part of solicitation is forbidden; Recording Academy chapters cannot be conduits for gifting; tickets not acquired via personal affiliation must be purchased at full price.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mailings to Recording Academy offices are prohibited
rubrics_metrics.description: “Any mailing of FYC product or marketing materials to any of the Recording Academy offices is prohibited, and will not be distributed to members, governors or trustees. Such mailings will be disposed of or returned to sender, [at] the Recording Academy’s sole discretion.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not send physical FYC materials to Academy offices; they will be discarded or returned.

rubrics_metrics.name: Telephone lobbying is prohibited
rubrics_metrics.description: “Contacting Academy members by phone to promote a Grammy-eligible product or achievement is prohibited, even if such contact is in the guise of checking to make sure a sample product or other product was received.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No phone solicitations of members for FYC purposes, including pretexts such as checking delivery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Corrective actions for guideline violations
rubrics_metrics.description: “If any activity is determined to work in opposition to the Recording Academy’s guidelines, the Academy may take any corrective actions, including disqualification of entries. Furthermore, any member who has authorized, executed or otherwise enabled a voting solicitation activity that is deemed to have undermined the letter or spirit of the Academy’s regulations may be subject to suspension or termination of Recording Academy membership.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consequences include disqualification of submissions and membership suspension/termination; the Academy enforces both letter and spirit of rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unlisted tactics are not automatically acceptable — consult Academy
rubrics_metrics.description: “It should not be assumed that any tactics or activities not specifically prohibited by these regulations are acceptable. The Recording Academy is willing to review any materials or answer any questions that arise in advance.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When in doubt about a novel tactic, seek pre-clearance from the Academy rather than assuming permissibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Encouragement to report suspected violations
rubrics_metrics.description: “We encourage our community to help us avoid and remedy violations of these guidelines and ask that you report any findings…”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Community reporting is part of enforcement; members and industry participants are urged to report suspected breaches.
